purpose: Test whether Train-only ItemCF's complementary candidates become final ranking gains when appended to, rather than replacing, the V2 two-tower candidate pool and scored by the fixed V2 DeepFM ranker.

common_validation_cohort.definition: Ranking Validation click-positive rows whose encoded user/movie pair exactly matches Retrieval Validation

baseline: V2 two-tower top-50 candidates, scored by fixed V2 DeepFM, report ranked Recall@10 and NDCG@10 on the common cohort.
candidate: The same two-tower top-50 plus ItemCF recent-100 unique candidates up to a maximum pool size of 100, scored by the same frozen DeepFM; no retraining and no candidate score blending.
single_core_variable: candidate_pool_expansion=append ItemCF unique candidates; all retrieval, ranking model weights, cohort, scoring, and final K remain fixed.
acceptance_rule: Advance only if candidate improves common-cohort Recall@10 by at least 0.003 and NDCG@10 by at least 0.002, while common-cohort tail-PQ0 Recall@10 is non-inferior within 0.002. Otherwise retain the negative result and do not deploy or tune pool size.
integrity_rules: No post-result change to ItemCF bound=100, two-tower top-50, pool cap=100, or thresholds.
Do not use sealed Test or any prior invalid ranking run.
This evaluator produces no deployment action.
